verdict.rationale: GoDaddy's API surface is broad—domain search, registration, DNS, renewals, lock, forwarding, transfers, auctions, plus commerce (stores, catalog, customers, orders, tax) and notifications/usage data—suggesting substantial API/UI parity for domains and commerce. However, no evidence addresses parity for other GoDaddy UI products (hosting, email, website builder, SSL, security add-ons) that are prominent in the dashboard, so full parity across the whole UI is unconfirmed. Missing for 10: explicit statement or evidence of API coverage for non-domain/commerce UI features (hosting, email, SSL, website builder) and any documented gaps or exceptions.
